question: If the full Lord has no real spatial divisions, why speak of them?
premises: The full Lord has no real above, beginning, middle, or end.
Teaching still addresses learners and teachers.
Pedagogical needs can justify provisional divisions.
inference: Spatial divisions are not ultimately real but are used for the sake of teaching and understanding.
plain_english: For that full reality there is no real arrangement of above, beginning, middle, or end; even so, such divisions are used for the sake of those who learn and those who teach.
